stories.title: fittleworth.com listed by Scarlettgroup ransomware
stories.summary: Fittleworth is a UK healthcare company providing home delivery of medical supplies and support for people with stomas, continence needs, and wounds.
stories.rookie: Criminals lock (encrypt) or steal a company's files, then demand money.
actions: Check whether any client shares the victim's sector, suppliers or software.
Confirm clients have offline or immutable backups and have tested a restore.
Look up the gang on ransomware.live to see its usual way in (initial access).
enrich_steps: Domain → WHOIS / Nominet for .uk, passive DNS, certificate transparency (crt.sh)
Victim → Companies House (sector SIC code, size, directors) → which clients share suppliers or sector

stories.title: Attackers Exploit UnrealIRCd Flaw That Enables Server-Level Command Injection

The vulnerability, tracked as CVE-2026-114713 (CVSS score: 8.6), is a case of improper neutralization of delimiters
stories.rookie: Attackers are already using this weakness in real attacks, not just in theory.
actions: On CISA KEV: patch or mitigate for UK clients now, do not wait.
Treat as patch-now: check the CISA KEV due date and the EPSS score.
Search client external attack surface for the affected product and version.
enrich_steps: CVE → EPSS + KEV + vendor advisory → which client assets run it (Shodan/Censys query filtered to country:GB)
